nodes.name: PollingFeed.js

contract.kind: Planned polling motor · empty subclass in current source
contract.implemented: Class declaration only; no export, timer, fetch override or cancellation yet.

semanticsAndFlow.flow: Current source only declares class PollingFeed extends Feed. The left-to-right flow shows intended integration. There is no running polling motor yet.

enablingConcepts.name: Sequential scheduling
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Wait for work to settle before scheduling another request.
enablingConcepts.details: A timer alone does not implement backpressure or lifecycle safety.

enablingConcepts.name: Cooperative cancellation
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Allow callers to signal that work is no longer needed.
enablingConcepts.details: Aborting a fetch does not guarantee immediate TCP socket closure. A generation check can prevent late completions from affecting restarted feeds.

nodes.name: pipeline.js

invariants: validateSchema checks required field presence and returns the same object.
normalizeTimestamps and enrichFeedMetadata return shallow copies. Nested values remain shared.
Timestamp fallback and ingestedAt use Date.now(); these stages are not strictly pure.
Timestamp units are inferred by magnitude. This heuristic is not valid for every date or API.

semanticsAndFlow.flow: Raw text → parseJson → required-field presence checks → timestamp normalization → metadata. Open Trace a payload to run these exact functions. No React subscriber or network poller is connected here.

enablingConcepts.name: Currying and composition
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Configure a transformation before supplying its data.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Schema and feed ID configuration produce unary pipeline stages.
enablingConcepts.details: Currying is a design choice; pipe can also compose ordinary unary functions.

enablingConcepts.name: Shallow copying
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Avoid overwriting fields on the input object.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Normalization and enrichment spread the input into a new object.
enablingConcepts.details: Validation returns the original object. New identity does not guarantee rendering or a frame rate; nested references remain shared.

enablingConcepts.name: Time-dependent transforms
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Attach ingestion time and handle missing timestamps.
enablingConcepts.details: This introduces nondeterminism. The timestamp threshold is a heuristic; inspect edge cases rather than assuming every input is normalized correctly.

nodes.name: Feed.js

invariants: Private fields restrict direct access; public methods still mutate internal state.
Endpoint copies are shallow. Nested objects would still be shared.
The new.target guard blocks direct Feed construction, but does not force subclasses to override methods.
start, stop and fetch throw unless overridden.

semanticsAndFlow.flow: Starts IDLE. setStatus accepts any member of the allowed status set; it does not enforce a transition graph. recordSuccess and recordFailure update telemetry but do not change status. There is no circuit breaker threshold or request gating in the current source.

enablingConcepts.name: Private fields
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Restrict direct access to internal fields.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: The class owns status, endpoint storage and telemetry.
enablingConcepts.details: Encapsulation is not immutability. Methods of this class can still change private state.

enablingConcepts.name: Defensive copying
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Avoid sharing the endpoint array container with callers.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Constructor and getter create array copies.
enablingConcepts.details: Copies are shallow and do not clone nested objects.

enablingConcepts.name: Abstract-method convention
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Make unsupported direct use fail early.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: new.target rejects new Feed; base lifecycle methods throw.
enablingConcepts.details: JavaScript does not verify that a subclass overrides those methods. No automatic circuit breaker is implemented.

nodes.name: helpers.js

semanticsAndFlow.flow: pipe() runs reduce; parseJson shields native SyntaxErrors as domain ParseErrors.

enablingConcepts.name: Left-to-Right Function Composition (pipe)
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Category theory composition implemented via Array.prototype.reduce.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Readable linear transformation flow pipe(f, g, h)(x) === h(g(f(x))).
enablingConcepts.details: Executes synchronously, passing accumulator output to next stage.

enablingConcepts.name: Boundary Exception Shielding
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Intercepts SyntaxError and stamps with telemetry-aware ParseError.
enablingConcepts.details: Passthrough if input is already parsed object.

nodes.name: assertions.js

semanticsAndFlow.flow: Queries VALIDATORS[type] -> checkType -> isEmpty -> throws TypeError / RangeError.

enablingConcepts.name: Fail-Fast Invariant Enforcement
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Jim Gray (Turing Award). Halts execution at the exact point of invalid input.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Ensures no Feed can be created with corrupt ID or empty endpoints.
enablingConcepts.details: Distinguishes TypeError (wrong primitive) from RangeError (empty bounds).

nodes.name: validators.js

semanticsAndFlow.flow: Supplies type and bounds checking logic to assertions.js.

enablingConcepts.name: Data-Driven Strategy Pattern
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: GoF Strategy Pattern to decouple rule logic from assertion mechanisms.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Extensible validation predicates without modifying constructor code.
enablingConcepts.details: Uses Array.isArray and Number.isNaN to defend against JS type coercion flaws.

nodes.name: errors.js

semanticsAndFlow.flow: Carries feedId and HTTP statusCode across system boundaries for automated triage.

enablingConcepts.name: Prototypal Error Hierarchy & Telemetry Tagging
enablingConcepts.inventedFor: Enables instanceof discrimination in catch blocks without string parsing.
enablingConcepts.solvesForUs: Downstream catch triage: retry NetworkError vs quarantine ParseError.
enablingConcepts.details: Inherits V8 stack trace capture while stamping feedId and statusCode.
